proof_scope: Operator-armed Pi task budgets, named checks, terminal acceptance and output-only repair

claims.proves: Tool path restrictions and raw/custom-tool refusal in an armed budget, frozen check definitions, cache reuse for unchanged passing inputs, two repair attempts, review/elapsed deadlines, terminal acceptance, explicit question mode and one tool-free formatting repair. Live Pi produces an independently checked artifact with exactly one approved check and zero post-acceptance tool calls.
claims.does_not_prove: OS-level confinement of explicitly approved commands, arbitrary external-state freshness, hostile same-user tamper resistance, automatic classification of natural-language questions, or activation in already-open sessions. Lifecycle adversarial probes use synthetic Pi events; the artifact run uses a real model and real tools.
